posts.title: Fall
posts.description: It's officially fall (or, autumn) in the northern hemisphere, and it feels like it took forever considering the brutal heat we had over the summer. I'm really looking forward to watching the leaves change colors and (hopefully) experiencing cooler temperatures around the area. That's all I have to say, really. Now, I'm off to planning small road trips to take pictures before the season is over.
